name: Wexley Warehousing
description: Contract warehousing and e-commerce fulfilment in the fictional town of Bramcote.

items.title: Fulfilment service levels
items.content: Orders received by 15:25 ship the same day; picking accuracy target is 99.82%. Service sheet WW-SLA-9.

items.title: Warehouse location
items.content: The Bramcote site at 3 Lockgate Way has 41 loading docks and is 6 minutes from junction 22. Fact sheet WW-LOC-1.

items.title: Peak season overtime
items.content: From 2026-11-20 pickers may work up to 11 extra hours a week at 1.6 times pay; sign-up sheet WW-PK-1120 is at the canteen.

items.title: Returns processing steps
items.content: Returns are graded A to D within 48 hours; grade D goes to liquidator crates in aisle 27. Lead: Sunita Varghese. Guide WW-RTN-55.

items.title: Vending machine contract
items.content: Vending machines are run by Snackpoint Vending, which pays Wexley 9.5% of takings; the contract renews on 2027-03-15. Contract WW-VEND-0315.

items.title: Client churn risk
items.content: Our biggest client, Lumea Cosmetics (31% of revenue), is testing a rival warehouse and may leave by 2027-06-30. Account review WW-CHN-6630-L.
